scope: Small-scale / micro data center cooling products (rack-level, ≤120 kW class). Compiled from manufacturer pages and trade press. Prices are generally not published in this industry (❌).

products.note: No liquid-cooled micro DC models — stops at air-cooling limits

products.cooling: Air (closed loop, ~3.5 kW class; optional DX)
products.note: Vertiv's liquid cooling line (CoolChip CDU 70+) starts at 70 kW and is a component, not a turnkey cabinet

products.facility_free: No facility water, but needs room AC headroom
products.note: Component-level product for AI racks; publishes capacity-vs-ambient curves (rare!)
Closest comparable product; launched 2018, limited updates since; channels mostly EU/US

products.cooling: Air-side precision cooling (name says 'liquid' = refrigerant/chilled water inside the AC)
products.facility_free: DX variant yes; CW needs chilled water
products.note: Common misconception: LCP is rack air-conditioning, NOT server liquid cooling

products.facility_free: No — needs tempered water loop (dry cooler etc.)

products.note: Explicit edge framing: 'add liquid cooling without changing the room'

gap_statement: Turnkey, facility-free liquid-cooled cabinets in the 20-50 kW class are essentially uncovered: major-vendor micro DCs stop at ~10 kW air cooling, and their liquid products start at 40-70 kW as components for AI data centers. The only full predecessor is the 2018 STULZ×CoolIT Micro DC.
caveats: Prices are not publicly listed by any vendor in this segment (❌) — budget via RFQ.
Certification status (CE/UL/local) must be confirmed per market with each vendor.
Data compiled 2026-09; verify currency before citing in procurement documents.
